# protoc.generate writes Go code through protoc-gen-go, tracks the files its
# sources import from the include paths, treats a descriptor set named in
# flags as an output, and --clean removes the files it generated.
[!exec:protoc] skip
[!exec:protoc-gen-go] skip

bit
stdout 'gen ▶ protoc -Iapi -Ishared --go_out=gen --go_opt=paths=source_relative --descriptor_set_out=desc.pb api/demo/\*\.proto'
stdout 'gen ✔ ok'
exists gen/demo/user.pb.go gen/demo/role.pb.go desc.pb
grep 'package demo' gen/demo/user.pb.go
! exists gen/ids.pb.go

bit
stdout 'gen · no changes'

# The imported file is not a source, but changing it regenerates.
cp ids.proto.changed shared/ids.proto
bit
stdout '''shared/ids\.proto'' changed'
stdout 'gen ✔ ok'

# So does changing a source.
cp role.proto.changed api/demo/role.proto
bit
stdout '''api/demo/role\.proto'' changed'
grep 'ROLE_ADMIN' gen/demo/role.pb.go

# A removed descriptor set or generated file is written again.
rm desc.pb
bit
stdout '''desc\.pb'' \(removed\) changed'
exists desc.pb

rm gen/demo/user.pb.go
bit
stdout 'gen/demo/user\.pb\.go was changed or removed'
exists gen/demo/user.pb.go

bit --clean
stdout 'gen ▶ rm gen/demo/role\.pb\.go'
stdout 'gen ▶ rm gen/demo/user\.pb\.go'
! exists gen/demo/role.pb.go gen/demo/user.pb.go
exists api/demo/user.proto shared/ids.proto

-- BUILD.bit --
gen = protoc.generate {
  sources = ["api/demo/*.proto"]
  include = ["api", "shared"]
  out     = { go = "gen" }
  opt     = { go = "paths=source_relative" }
  flags   = ["--descriptor_set_out=desc.pb"]
}
-- api/demo/user.proto --
syntax = "proto3";
package demo;
option go_package = "example.com/demo";

import "ids.proto";
import "demo/role.proto";

message User {
  ids.Id id = 1;
  Role role = 2;
}
-- api/demo/role.proto --
syntax = "proto3";
package demo;
option go_package = "example.com/demo";

enum Role {
  ROLE_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
}
-- role.proto.changed --
syntax = "proto3";
package demo;
option go_package = "example.com/demo";

enum Role {
  ROLE_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
  ROLE_ADMIN = 1;
}
-- shared/ids.proto --
syntax = "proto3";
package ids;
option go_package = "example.com/ids";

message Id {
  string value = 1;
}
-- ids.proto.changed --
syntax = "proto3";
package ids;
option go_package = "example.com/ids";

message Id {
  string value = 1;
  int64 version = 2;
}
